environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.xlarge) running Tomcat 8.5 with Apache Commons Collections 3.2.1 on classpath. Instance is in a private subnet (10.0.4.0/24) but the security group (sg-0a8f3e2b) allows inbound TCP/8080 from 10.0.0.0/8. The VPC has a NAT gateway for outbound. Other services in the same VPC (10.0.0.0/16) can reach the endpoint directly. The INTERNAL_SERVICE_KEY is shared across 14 microservices via a common Secrets Manager secret. No JVM serialization filters configured (-Djdk.serialFilter not set). JDK 8u232.
